item.title: Morning Briefing 2026-03-16
item.description:
Good morning. Today is Monday, March 16th, 2026. Welcome to your morning market briefing.
We begin with the week's most significant scheduled event for financial markets. The Federal Reserve is expected to hold interest rates steady when it concludes its meeting on Wednesday. This would mark the second consecutive meeting without a rate change. Later in the week, on Thursday, both the European Central Bank and the Bank of England will announce their policy decisions.
